chunks: And Isḥāq ibn ʿAmmār narrated; he said:
I said to Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام: "May the owned servant look at the hair of his mistress?" He said: "Yes, and at her ساق as well."

key_terms.الْمَمْلُوكُ: the owned male servant or slave

ai.seo_question: Can a male slave look at the hair and ساق of his mistress according to Imam al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith records a legal question posed to Imam Jaʿfar ibn Muḥammad al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام regarding the looking of a male slave at the hair of his mistress. The Imam عليه السلام replies affirmatively and extends that permission to her ساق as well, indicating a fiqh ruling in this specific relational context.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.4632 - Ishaq ibn Ammar narrated that he said to Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as): "Can a servant look at the hair of his mistress?"
The Imam replied: "Yes, and at her legs as well."
